Name: Skip Text (Scrolling)
Author: BalaurBohemianBroken
Description:
Are you tired of having to wait for people's slow mouths to finish their sentences?
Does clicking to fast forward eat up too much of your time?
Are you speeding through Linus' romance tree?

Try: Skip Text (Scroll)!

[color=#e69138][size=5]what it do[/size][/color]
Immediately skips to the end of a dialogue box's text, letting you go through dialogue much quicker

[color=#e69138][size=5]install[/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url] (Yes it's necessary)
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]fast

[/list]
[color=#e69138][size=5]plans[/size][/color]
I was thinking of improving on this to allow users to very quickly skip through all dialogue that pops up, maybe with a keybind or something.
If that interests you, lemme know and I'll throw it together.

[color=#e69138][size=5]bugs[/size][/color]
nah

[color=#e69138][size=5]special thanks[/size][/color]
to an inconsequential issue in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8923]my other mod[/url] that encouraged me to make this.
